source: Expanded from the existing LaCurent MC001/6-2013 climate dataset and Romanian locality geography already present in the repository.

source_document.title: Metodologie de calcul al performantei energetice a cladirilor. Partea a VI-a - Parametrii climatici necesari determinarii performantei energetice a cladirilor noi si existente, dimensionarii instalatiilor de climatizare a cladirilor si dimensionarii higrotermice a elementelor de anvelopa ale cladirilor

station_resolution: Exact MC001 station when the selected locality is one of the 42 source stations; otherwise nearest MC001/6-2013 station by WGS84 locality point distance.
